dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Four prominent structures identified: one centrally located elliptical 'O' with a jagged light-gray perimeter, one large posterior multi-lobed 'C' shape, one smaller circular 'O' on the dorsal ridge, and an elongated 'C' shape in the posterior-ventral quadrant; all structures feature high-contrast light perimeters against a uniform dark interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density; discrete clusters of solid high-intensity white pixels are concentrated on the dorsal neck and anterior dorsal midline, appearing as localized flecks without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the central 'O', posterior 'C', and dorsal 'O' structures define an obtuse scalene triangle spanning the mid-to-posterior dorsal-lateral field.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive reticulated network of light-gray filamentary lines forming a web-like pattern that connects the primary macro-annuli across the central lateral surface.
